entities.summary: Gilbert Armea Garcera is a Filipino Catholic prelate. He has been the metropolitan archbishop of Lipa since 2017, and president of the Catholic Bishops' Conference of the Philippines since 2025. His previous assignment was as the bishop of the Diocese of Daet in Camarines Norte.
